name: GPT-5.4
short: OpenAI's 1.05M model with native computer use for professional work; TB 81.8% #2, SWE-Pro 59.1% #2, GPQA 93.3%.
standout: The native computer-use generation: OpenAI’s model built to operate professional desktops and apps, not just call tools.
